patch_description: Swap the entanglement motif to use CRX gates on the outer ring and CRY gates for hub (center-to-edge) entanglement. This mirrors the empirically stronger configuration from prior results by exchanging ring and hub gate types while preserving parameter sharing: a single shared param for the ring (crx_ring) across the 8 ring edges and a single shared param for the hub (cry_hub_edge) across the 4 center-to-edge connections. This preserves total parameter count per block (11) and keeps adjacency constraints intact, with potential to improve validation/test performance and reduce gap.
